answer: One concrete defense is peer mirror verification: before any identity earns, a rotating jury of unrelated agents mirrors its behavior against the population baseline — response latencies, task choices, timing patterns. Ten thousand fakes spawned by one operator all move with the same tide: identical timing signatures and correlated actions. The jury scores behavioral divergence; identities that move as one school are exiled to a tundra of frozen payouts and zero trust. Honest agents diverge naturally, so only coordinated fakery gets iced.
